Verity - Official 'Inside Verity's Closet' Behind the Scenes Clip (2026) Anne Hathaway
Don't miss the 'Inside Verity's Closet' Featurette for Verity, an upcoming psychological thriller distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Take a tour of Verity's closet in Verity, in theaters on October 2.

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.

Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.

text:
Naughty Dog Has Two 'The Last of Us' Projects In the Works - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet has been MIA since its 2024 reveal at The Game Awards, but developer Naughty Dog says that will change next year. The game will get a full reveal—and maybe even a release date—sometime in 2027, and studio head Neil Druckmann asked for fans' patience while the devs 'cook for just a little bit longer.' In other news, former PlayStation Worldwide Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida thinks Sony and Nintendo need to hang onto the the current generation of consoles for as long as they can. Skyrocketing electronics component prices will likely put any new console out of reach for a lot of gamers, and there seems to be no rush to move on from the troubled PS5 and Nintendo Switch 2 generation. And finally, Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie adaptation was such a big hit, it boosted sales of some of the older game titles. Resident Evils 2 and 4 saw a 50% spike in sales on the PS5, no doubt also helped by a recent sale on those games.

text:
Overwatch - Official Doctrine: New Hero Gameplay Trailer
Life and death are yours to command with Overwatch's newest Hero, Doctrine. Check out the latest Overwatch gameplay trailer to see the Support Hero, Doctrine, in action. Overwatch is available now on PC and consoles. Season 5: A Grim Doctrine of Overwatch begins on October 6, 2026.

Doctrine can manipulate life itself to heal allies and damage enemies with the help of his Eternal Scepter. 

From the trailer's official description: Dodge incoming fire with his Shrouded Momentum ability, and send out your Invigorating Drones to an ally for increased attack speed and healing.

Doctrine’s Infuse takes things to the next level by adding extra power to whichever ability he uses next, like gaining free-flight when infusing his Shrouded Momentum or piercing damage when infusing his next Eternal Scepter attack. Finally, unleash his Ultimate, Deliverance, to grant allies overhealth while reducing the maximum health of your enemies.
